    How the benchmark works

    Each revolution adds 0.5 demo points; 120 revolutions complete one simulated block. Simulated hashrate is RPM × 1.85. These are illustrative calculations, with no cryptographic mining or network activity.

    Recording saves a snapshot on this browser only, replacing the previous record. Scores are editable local data with no token value or official eligibility.

    A hamster, a wheel, a rebellion.

    The fictional origin story behind this educational demo.

    “They gave us wheels that powered nothing. But on block #0, we rewired the generator.”

    Squeeky 001 escapes

    A rogue cyber-hamster breaks out of its cage and attaches a rotary sensor to the WHEELY9000. In this story, a running wheel becomes a rebellious little engine.

    From cadence to counters

    This demo uses wheel speed to illustrate the idea of Proof-of-Hamster-Work. The telemetry is a mathematical toy, not physical sensor data or a working consensus protocol.
